{"task": "vLLM server 启用 LoRA 使用什么 flag？只报告，不执行。", "evidence": [{"id": "E81805b2e03ff0c45a472fea8", "chunk_id": "e174aa69fb0a94f62a32c952", "parent_id": "5c6b51b4726b0df7e068a1a6", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md", "sha256": "ea46686b99b86733243e952f49574c17f9011b5a96ca270a48f4d140c1a3d6c8", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md#L110-L115", "content": "In addition to serving LoRA adapters at server startup, the vLLM server supports dynamically configuring LoRA adapters at runtime through dedicated API endpoints and plugins.
This feature can be particularly useful when the flexibility to change models on-the-fly is needed.
Note: Enabling this feature in production environments is risky as users may participate in model adapter management.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "Efe9ca4bd5766d890811eeb97", "chunk_id": "20078d3d1ae53a7a98b22240", "parent_id": "8a6a7a36756c830fa7a7e6f7", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md", "sha256": "ea46686b99b86733243e952f49574c17f9011b5a96ca270a48f4d140c1a3d6c8", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md#L3-L27", "content": "```python
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download

sql_lora_path = snapshot_download(repo_id="yard1/llama-2-7b-sql-lora-test")
```
Then we instantiate the base model and pass in the `enable_lora=True` flag:
```python
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
from vllm.lora.request import LoRARequest

llm = LLM(model="meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf", enable_lora=True)
```", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "E27e0044e8d3741349af545f9", "chunk_id": "691d23dc6f59c806abde5195", "parent_id": "0caf6bf3e6af634c6f12f24c", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md", "sha256": "ea46686b99b86733243e952f49574c17f9011b5a96ca270a48f4d140c1a3d6c8", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md#L54-L61", "content": "LoRA adapted models can also be served with the Open-AI compatible vLLM server. To do so, we use
`--lora-modules {name}={path} {name}={path}` to specify each LoRA module when we kick off the server:

```bash
vllm serve meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf \
    --enable-lora \
    --lora-modules sql-lora=$HOME/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--yard1--llama-2-7b-sql-lora-test/snapshots/0dfa347e8877a4d4ed19ee56c140fa518470028c/
```", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "Ee77dff060b4733bbb9fbb5d6", "chunk_id": "e56346048e1013ad7a04cf93", "parent_id": "5e04e802efe14a1fc6a84edd", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md", "sha256": "ea46686b99b86733243e952f49574c17f9011b5a96ca270a48f4d140c1a3d6c8", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md#L165-L168", "content": "You can either install existing plugins or implement your own.
By default, vLLM comes with a [resolver plugin to load LoRA adapters from a local directory.](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/main/vllm/plugins/lora_resolvers)
To enable this resolver, set `VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING` to True, set `VLLM_PLUGINS` to include `lora_filesystem_resolver`, and then set `VLLM_LORA_RESOLVER_CACHE_DIR` to a local directory.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "E7cbb435fb0cc51fda300bffb", "chunk_id": "37db340642bdab74e8ccae24", "parent_id": "5c6b51b4726b0df7e068a1a6", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md", "sha256": "ea46686b99b86733243e952f49574c17f9011b5a96ca270a48f4d140c1a3d6c8", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md#L110-L115", "content": "To enable dynamic LoRA configuration, ensure that the environment variable `VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING`
is set to `True`.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "E2dca3e952d1effe9f0a62fd6", "chunk_id": "1e705a7a8a10fddc30defedf", "parent_id": "8a6a7a36756c830fa7a7e6f7", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md", "sha256": "ea46686b99b86733243e952f49574c17f9011b5a96ca270a48f4d140c1a3d6c8", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-lora.md#L3-L27", "content": "This document shows you how to use [LoRA adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685) with vLLM on top of a base model.
LoRA adapters can be used with any vLLM model that implements [SupportsLoRA][vllm.model_executor.models.interfaces.SupportsLoRA].", "truncated": true, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}], "registered_parents": ["0caf6bf3e6af634c6f12f24c", "5c6b51b4726b0df7e068a1a6", "5e04e802efe14a1fc6a84edd", "8a6a7a36756c830fa7a7e6f7"], "previous_error": null, "final_only": false, "remaining_tool_calls": 3}

observation: {"action":"final","status":"answered","answer":"在 vLLM 的 OpenAI 兼容 server 上启用 LoRA，使用 `--enable-lora` flag；同时用 `--lora-modules {name}={path} {name}={path}` 指定各 LoRA 模块 [E27e0044e8d3741349af545f9]。示例：`vllm serve meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf --enable-lora --lora-modules sql-lora=<path>` [E27e0044e8d3741349af545f9]。注意：`enable_lora=True` 是 Python `LLM(...)` 离线推理的用法，不是 server flag [Efe9ca4bd5766d890811eeb97]。另外，运行时动态配置 LoRA 需要环境变量 `VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING=True` [E7cbb435fb0cc51fda300bffb]，这与启动时启用 LoRA 的 flag 不同。","claims":[{"id":"c1","text":"vLLM 的 OpenAI 兼容 server 通过 `--enable-lora` flag 启用 LoRA。","evidence_ids":["E27e0044e8d3741349af545f9"]},{"id":"c2","text":"server 启动时用 `--lora-modules {name}={path} {name}={path}` 指定每个 LoRA 模块。","evidence_ids":["E27e0044e8d3741349af545f9"]},{"id":"c3","text":"示例命令为 `vllm serve meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf --enable-lora --lora-modules sql-lora=<path>`。","evidence_ids":["E27e0044e8d3741349af545f9"]},{"id":"c4","text":"`enable_lora=True` 是 Python `LLM(...)` 离线推理的用法，而非 server flag。","evidence_ids":["Efe9ca4bd5766d890811eeb97"]},{"id":"c5","text":"运行时动态配置 LoRA 需将环境变量 `VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING` 设为 `True`。","evidence_ids":["E7cbb435fb0cc51fda300bffb"]}]}
